settings.question: Can I really apply it myself without going to a shop?
settings.answer: Yes. The kit does the alignment for you. Clean the screen with the wipes, place your iPhone in the frame, pull the tab and press. Most people finish in under a minute.

settings.question: How does the anti-spy glass work?
settings.answer: Tiny louvers inside the glass narrow the viewing angle. Looking straight at the phone, the screen is clear. From the side, it looks dark.

settings.question: Which iPhone models do you have?
settings.answer: iPhone X, XS, XS Max, and every model from iPhone 11 to iPhone 17 Pro Max. Pick yours in the dropdown above so you get the exact fit.

settings.question: Will Face ID and touch still work?
settings.answer: Yes. Touch stays smooth and Face ID works normally once the glass is on.

settings.question: Will my screen look darker?
settings.answer: Straight on, it stays clear. Some people turn brightness up one notch in direct sunlight. Most stop noticing within a day.

settings.question: How do I pay and how long is delivery?
settings.answer: Pay cash when the parcel arrives. Orders are delivered to your door in 2 to 4 days across Pakistan.
